source.title: Belfast Newsletter, 8 June 1964, p. 9 ("Hillsborough Rural District Council: notice of result of elections, 1964")
source.publisher: Belfast Newsletter (via the British Newspaper Archive)
source.check: the returning officer’s notice of result in the Belfast News-Letter of 8 June 1964, with the counts from the report of 5 June.

note: Triennial election of Hillsborough Rural District Council, polled Thursday 4 June 1964. Hillsborough, Maze and Anahilt were contested and the other thirteen divisions were returned unopposed. Addresses and occupations printed with the names are not reproduced (privacy rule; gap-fill 6 Nov 2026). Returned unopposed.
correctionNote: Corrected from the page images of the Belfast News-Letter, 5 June 1964, p. 2 and 8 June 1964, p. 9 (council-audit, Nov 2026): the round note now says Hillsborough, Maze and Anahilt were contested (it said Maze recorded a poll for a single candidate; the defeated Maze candidate had been filed under Hillsborough).
